scope: Adaptive development on the same 4977 Okutama centers; not external confirmation

a3_unrestricted_templates.purpose: class-specific visibility, nuisance and cost privilege control

a5_sear.purpose: primary shared-evidence appearance plus relative geometry

architecture.capacity_match: A1-A5 active trainable counts must each be within5percent of A5; no inert padding
architecture.common_video: identical CommonVideoHead implementation and dimensions in every arm
architecture.fallback: all missing local evidence must return exact video-only logits
architecture.geometry: common row-major normalized patch-center (x,y) coordinates on the pinned27x27 DINO grid for A1-A5

inputs.dense_center_source: original locked center crop and pinned DINOv2-base final hidden state
inputs.video_recipe: original short V-JEPA mean concatenated with regenerated long V-JEPA mean; exact original fallback policy
inputs.feature_scaling: frozen encoder outputs enter model LayerNorm directly; no global or held-row fitted scaler
inputs.augmentations: none in v1 cached-token matrix; identical across all arms

splitting.selection: pooled inner OOF macro-F1 descending, NLL ascending, learning-rate ascending, weight-decay ascending
splitting.outer_refit_epochs: rounded median of the three selected inner best epochs, minimum1

training.batch_size_status: fixed before classifier fitting; full A0-A5 synthetic resource gate must pass
training.regularization_policy: same shared-extractor compactness and batch-level slot-balance losses in A3-A5; no per-image all-slot presence requirement
training.outer_metric_embargo: outer labels are not scored or logged by individual fits; results release only after the exact450-fit matrix validates

requirements: finite forward and backward for every arm
every active parameter receives a finite gradient
common video state dictionaries are compatible
all-missing local evidence is exact video fallback

fixed_diagnostics.coordinate_shuffle: one fixed global permutation of patch-center coordinates while token order is retained
fixed_diagnostics.outer_border_mask: set matchability to zero on the outer four-patch border, retain the central19x19 field and physical-support denominator
fixed_diagnostics.video_branch_removal: softmax of local logits alone; missing local evidence becomes uniform
fixed_diagnostics.crop_jitter: deferred zero-fit diagnostic requiring a separately provenance-locked DINO extraction; no crop-jitter cache is available to v1 classifier fitting
fixed_diagnostics.interpretation: diagnostics can falsify coordinate, context, video or slot-mechanism reliance but never select or route predictions

statistics.multiplicity: Holm over exactly the six directional contrasts

diagnostics: rescues harms and original shared-failure repairs
slot mass collapse and batch utilization
